name: [🗺️ NEW MAP] Voltline: Electric Scooters [Beta]
desc:
Ride electric scooters, make food deliveries, and build your own setup in Voltline.

📦 Unpack and assemble your first AOVOPRO ES80.
🛴 Earn your way toward a VSETT 9+ or KuKirin G4, each with its own unboxing and assembly.
🔧 Fit compatible batteries, motors, controllers, brakes, tires, and suspension.
📱 Use your in-game phone for deliveries, navigation, shopping, and your garage.
🔋 Charge your scooter, watch your battery, and track the miles you ride.

EARLY TESTING · DESKTOP
Expect bugs, balance changes, and unfinished areas while we develop the game.

Follow Voltline for testing updates. When reporting a bug, include your scooter and what happened.

llm.loop: unbox and assemble an electric scooter -> do food deliveries with an in-game phone -> earn money -> fit batteries, motors and brakes -> work toward premium scooter models
llm.instructions: unpack and assemble, deliver, fit parts, charge, track miles; early testing on desktop
unique: hyper-real hobby sim using real scooter brands and models
llm.thumbnails: photoreal scooter rides along a lakeside road at sunset; a handlebar speedometer
llm.complexity_notes: realistic vehicle model, part system, delivery map
